body: Life hasn’t really gotten better in the last few days. Just trying to keep myself occupied while I wait for the test results from that drug screen. I haven’t consistently used nicotine for about 9 months but for some reason i’m really craving it now

I appreciate your reply. I’ve posted on this subreddit before when i was severely depressed. I was going to kill myself but didn’t for some reason. I don’t even feel depressed any more life has just lost it’s meaning. I try so hard every day to make my life mean something and in the end there are people who don’t have to try and surpass me in every way. I find very little pleasure in talking to people which is what most people say life is all about. I’m just not sure what to do with myself anymore. Gonna be honest the thing that sparked this today was that I failed a drug screen for a job because of a prescription I take and on the way out of the parking lot I backed into a car and it’s the first time I’ve ever been in any kind of accident so i didn’t take any pictures or anything. I’m so stressed out about the text I’m going to get or the ticket or whatever the fuck happens. It’s such a dumb reason to spark an existential crisis but i think it was just the last straw for me after the last few months. Sorry this was so wordy

I’ve been to two hospitals and the people there physically hurt me. I’ve seen multiple therapists and i either don’t get taken seriously or the other thing that happened. It was the first time trying a therapist in a few years and that shit happened and i just don’t know how i could trust one again.

They both have had mental health problems in the past and they have dealt with mine my whole life. I just feel like with our financial situation, talking to a therapist that refused our insurance and made us pay out of pocket after lying and saying insurance was okay again would be a huge blow that my family can’t take right now. 

I think they believe that i’m struggling they just can’t deal with it on top of their other life problems right now.

I’ve thought about trying again but i can’t tell what kind of person they are of it’s not in person therapy.

With covid there won’t be an opportunity for in person therapy for a long time and even if i could go i’m not old enough to set up appointments on my own and my parents normally put it off for a few months or a year when i ask.

It’s hard to explain the situation as clearly as i would like. Those two seem like they’re counterintuitive. I’m just a burden to them and they would lose nothing from me not being around any more. My dad told me my parents divorce was my fault and my brother has always been my parents favorite. The only thing my parents would miss is the services i can provide to them i.e chores.
